## Known Spells / Cantrips
- **Cantrips (Wizard, 3):** Fire Bolt, Mind Sliver, Minor Illusion
- **Cantrips (Strixhaven Initiate):** Mage Hand + one more Quandrix cantrip of your choice
- **Spellbook (1st):** Silvery Barbs, Shield, Mage Armor, Magic Missile, Detect Magic, Feather Fall
- **Strixhaven Initiate (Quandrix):** the two cantrips above and one 1st-level Quandrix spell of your choice from the Strixhaven book, cast once per long rest without a slot. Confirm the Quandrix list at session 1.

## Features & Traits

### Wizard
- **Arcane Recovery** (1/day, short rest: recover slots totalling up to half wizard level, rounded up).
- **Level 2, Chronurgy Magic:** Chronal Shift (reaction, 2/long rest: force a creature within 30 ft to reroll an attack, check or save you saw it make). Temporal Awareness (add INT mod to initiative).
- **Level plan (suggested):** Wizard 1-5 (levels 1-5), Fighter/Echo Knight 1-3 (levels 6-8, trained at Strixhaven), Wizard 6-7 (levels 9-10). Ends Wizard 7 / Fighter 3, ready to become Fighter 3 / Wizard 10 in Avernus.

### Kenku Racial (Multiverse)
- **Expert Duplication:** advantage when copying writing or craftwork.
- **Kenku Recall:** proficiency in two skills (Insight, Stealth); advantage on a check with a proficient skill, uses = proficiency bonus per long rest.
- **Mimicry:** reproduce any sound or voice heard; Insight DC 8 + PB + CHA (DC 9) to detect.
- **Speech:** Kairos talks normally. He prefers precision and silence to small talk.

### Quandrix Student Background
- **Skills:** Arcana, Nature. **Feat:** Strixhaven Initiate (Quandrix). Starts with a Quandrix primer and school uniform.

## Backstory & Notes
Kairos remembers one word and darkness. Magister Hesper Vael, an Owlin Lorehold archaeomancer, raised him in the Biblioplex stacks and says she found him lost in Faerûn. She is proud of him and afraid of him. He chose Quandrix over Lorehold because he wants to know *why* things happen, not only *what* happened. He believes luck is probability you don't understand yet.

**Relationships (start):** Hesper +2 (guardian), Professor Orrin -1 (dislikes him on sight). Everyone else 0.
